description: Voyager workflow assistant baseline. Keep cases stable; create v2 when product expectations change.

cases.instruction: Explain what a cron expression is in one short paragraph.
Create a workflow with exactly one Succeed state named Done. It is not scheduled.
Create a workflow that fetches the current weather for Mangaluru from a live weather service and returns it. If the live catalog has no matching tool, propose the missing MCP capability.

Create a workflow that computes the SHA-256 hex digest of an input string. If the live catalog has no matching resource, propose a deterministic local function with complete JSON stdin/stdout code and tests.

Create a workflow that calls OpenWeatherMap. The example credential is YOUR_API_KEY. Do not store credentials in generated code; use an MCP requirement when a credentialed external capability is missing.
Hello, tell me one friendly sentence.
